items.statement: The actual pushforward of the normalized Lebesgue Gibbs tilt under x->p+s*x is the normalized Lebesgue tilt with inverse-affine potential x->F(s^-1*(x-p)). The nonzero actual Lebesgue Jacobian cancels between partition and set numerator. This canonical identity alone makes no probability assertion.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel full space E, including dimension zero; any function F:E->R, any translation p:E and a real scale s!=0.

No continuity, measurability of F, exponential integrability, probability or moment premise. Equality is of Mathlib totalized normalized tilted measures; probability is a separate obligation for every consumer.
